title: The Data Integrity Crisis
subtitle: The prototype works. But can the team trust its data?
description: During early validation of the Project Amigo prototype, Daniel discovers inconsistencies in employee appraisal records and leave balances. Make a practical delivery decision: contain the defect, validate the mappings, and protect unaffected velocity.

stakeholders.name: Daniel Brooks
stakeholders.agenda: Reporting prototype data mismatches in appraisal records and leave balances for investigation.

stakeholders.name: Aarav Kapoor
stakeholders.agenda: Protecting delivery deadlines while ensuring unverified data is never signed off.

stakeholders.name: Marcus Reed
stakeholders.agenda: Authoritative enterprise data reconciliation and adherence to release gates.

stakeholders.name: Sophia Bennett
stakeholders.role: Head of HR Operations · ICICI Bank
stakeholders.agenda: Ensuring appraisal cycle readiness across 80,000 employees without data corruption.

objectives.label: Triage reported data inconsistencies in prototype test records
Decide containment approach without halting safe development
Create and confirm the structured Data Validation Plan
Protect critical appraisal milestone without exposing unverified data
